summary: Five programmes added under METHODOLOGY decision 15 (UAE green residence for investors and partners, UAE retiree residence with property or deposit, Sierra Leone GO-FOR-GOLD, Prince Edward Island investor stream, France exceptional economic contribution residence), with rules and launch or legal-basis events from stored documents. Existing rows with an empty program_id are assigned in program_id_assignments (rules) and other_assignments (observations, events); ordinary naturalisation rows stay without a programme and are listed in context_rows. The UAE property-owner residence on AED 10,000 monthly income (Res. 65/2022 art. 53) is out of scope and not added.

programs.name: UAE green residence for investors and partners (الإقامة الخضراء للمستثمر أو الشريك; Cabinet Resolution 65/2022 art. 41)
programs.notes: Five-year residence permit, renewable, without a sponsor or employer, for a foreigner who comes to the UAE as an investor or partner in a commercial project (Cabinet Resolution 65/2022, the executive regulation of Federal Decree-Law 29/2021, arts. 33(2), 38(2), 39(2) and 41; issued 12 Jul 2022, in force 3 Oct 2022). Conditions: the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP) approves the investment under an investor classification system set by its chairman; the investment or partnership must reach the ratios set by a decision of the chairman (capital held in several licences is added up); and the local authority approves and licenses the activity. The regulation prints no amount and the chairman's decision is not stored, so no price is recorded. Holders may sponsor first-degree relatives, and their parents may be included. The government news agency WAM (18 Apr 2022) says it replaces an earlier investor residence valid for 2 years only; that earlier permit's start and terms are not in a stored document. launched is the in-force date of Res. 65/2022. Current status not confirmed: the stored consolidated text (date of consolidation not shown) still contains art. 41. No counts of green residence permits for investors were found.

programs.name: UAE residence for retired foreigners with property or deposit (تصريح إقامة الأجنبي المتقاعد; Cabinet Resolution 65/2022 arts. 51-52)
programs.notes: Five-year renewable residence without a sponsor for a retired foreigner who worked at least 15 years before retiring (in or outside the UAE) or is at least 55, and who owns UAE property worth at least AED 1,000,000 (purchase or market value, as valued by the emirate's competent authority; mortgaged property counts if at least AED 1,000,000 of the mortgage has been paid off) or holds a deposit of at least AED 1,000,000, moved to a UAE financial institution within 60 days of the permit unless invested in the UAE (Cabinet Resolution 65/2022 arts. 34(3), 46, 51-52; in force 3 Oct 2022). The same article also accepts a fixed annual income of at least AED 240,000 instead of property or deposit; that option rests on income and is recorded only as one of this permit's rules (METHODOLOGY decision 15). No stored document shows whether a retiree permit existed before this regulation, so launched (the regulation's in-force date) may be later than the first retiree permit. Out of scope and not recorded: the separate residence for property owners on a monthly income of AED 10,000 with no property minimum (art. 53; decision 15). Current status not confirmed beyond the stored consolidated text. No counts found.

programs.name: Sierra Leone GO-FOR-GOLD programme (permanent residency through gold purchase and programme fees; special naturalisation of investors)
programs.notes: Run by the Sierra Leone Immigration Department with private promoters. By the promoters' account it has two parts: permanent residency through a gold bullion purchase and programme fees, and 'special naturalisation' of investors, with a company and a corporate bank account included. A press release in the Immigration Department's name (2 Jan 2025; the copy was found only on an industry site and gives a private press contact) says the GO-FOR-GOLD residency programme was launched in December 2024, and announces arrangements to naturalise high-net-worth investors and people of Sierra Leonean heritage; it gives no amounts and no legal basis. launched follows that press release; the promoters (Nov 2025) and TechCabal (2026) date the launch to January 2025. Promoters and press give USD 140,000 for the main applicant (fast-track citizenship in about 90 days), USD 100,000 on a heritage route for people of African ancestry (Jan 2025), USD 10,000-20,000 per dependant, a +1 business partner at USD 30,000 or USD 85,000 (the Nov 2025 update contradicts itself), and due-diligence fees. The promoters say citizenship is granted under the President's power in s. 27A of the Citizenship Act 1973 (legal_basis; the Act itself is not stored), that 13 families were naturalised in a six-month pilot, and that an amendment to the Act and a Citizenship (Special Naturalization) Regulation 2025 are pending; none of this was found in an official publication. Ordinary naturalisation needs 8 years' residence (15 for applicants not of Negro African descent). Current status not confirmed by a government source (the promoters said in Nov 2025 that it was active).

programs.name: Canada Prince Edward Island Provincial Nominee Program, investor stream
programs.notes: Provincial nomination route (leading to Canadian permanent residence) for people who invest in Prince Edward Island. According to the UK Migration Advisory Committee (Feb 2014, citing the agent website Investor Visa Canada), it opened in January 2014 with 400 places for 2014 and required net worth of at least C$600,000, management expertise, an investment of C$150,000 in a qualifying business and an intention to live in the province; the MAC adds that no further details were available and that the route resembles an entrepreneur route more than a passive investor route. No Prince Edward Island or federal document on the stream is stored, so whether January 2014 was its first opening, its later terms and its current status are not confirmed. No counts found: the stored IRCC provincial nominee tables give Prince Edward Island totals for all nominee streams together, and the 2014 CIC evaluation's Prince Edward Island figures concern the federal Immigrant Investor Program (can-iip).

programs.name: France residence card for an exceptional economic contribution (carte de résident pour contribution économique exceptionnelle)
programs.notes: Residence for a foreigner making a long-term, non-speculative investment of at least EUR 10 million in commercial or industrial assets in France, as listed in comparison tables by the UK Migration Advisory Committee (Feb 2014; residence requirement 183 days a year) and the IMF (2015 working paper and Vanuatu Article IV; inception year 2013). Neither table names the card; the name comes from Transparency International's 2018 report, which cites Decree No 2009-1114 of 11 September 2009 on the carte de résident for an exceptional economic contribution and dates a French residence-by-investment scheme to 2009 (amended 2016), but its table row describes the EUR 300,000 passeport talent (fra-passeport-talent-investor), so that 2009 date is not recorded as a launch event. launched follows the IMF table (2013); the decree and the law behind the card are not stored, and the two dates disagree. The 5-year citizenship qualifying period in the MAC and IMF tables is France's ordinary naturalisation period and is kept as a context row without a programme. Current status and counts not found.

ledger.contains: Cabinet Resolution 65/2022, executive regulation of Decree-Law 29/2021 (39 pages, Arabic; consolidated text that also mentions a later 'blue residence' annex, art. 77 bis, not included). Main text: visa and entry-permit types; residence permits (2 years standard; 5-year green residence for investors/partners, skilled workers with AED 15,000 salary, freelancers with AED 360,000 income; remote work USD 3,500 a month; retirees with AED 1 million property or deposit or AED 240,000 income, 5 years; property owners, AED 10,000 monthly income); family sponsorship (children to 25); 180-day absence rule with investors exempt; fines; repeal of Res. 8/2021; in force 3 Oct 2022. Annex on golden residence (pp. 29-39). Golden investor terms recorded earlier. Now recorded: green residence for investors and partners (are-green-residence-investor: 5-year validity art. 38(2), investment at ratios set by the ICP chairman with no amount art. 41(2), 60-day entry visa art. 33, investor exemption from the absence rule art. 60(9), launch event) and retiree residence (are-retiree-residence: 5 years art. 51; AED 1,000,000 property, mortgaged property paid off, or deposit; 60 days to move the deposit; age 55 or 15 years' service; AED 240,000 income option; 60-day entry visa art. 34(3); launch event). Out of scope (METHODOLOGY decision 15, routes resting on salary or income): skilled-worker and freelancer green residence, remote work, the property-owner residence of art. 53 (AED 10,000 monthly income, no property minimum); entrepreneur, talent, scientist, professional and student golden categories as before.

WAM, 18 Apr 2022: Cabinet approves the executive regulation of the entry and residence decree-law: 10-year golden residence (investor terms and event recorded earlier); 5-year green residence for skilled employees (AED 15,000), freelancers (AED 360,000) and investors/partners (replacing a 2-year permit); visit visas; grace periods; in force 90 days after publication. Now recorded for are-green-residence-investor: 5-year validity, the replaced 2-year permit, and the approval event (no amount given). Skilled-employee and freelancer tracks are salary or income routes, out of scope (decision 15); entrepreneur, talent and visa criteria out of scope.

IMF Working Paper WP/15/93 (2015), 'Too Much of a Good Thing? Prudent Management of Inflows under Economic Citizenship Programs': ECP inflows and fiscal data (Box 1, tables, Box 5), Box 2 statistics and buffers, recorded earlier. France Table 1 row decided: EUR 10 million (t-831cac8508) assigned to fra-exceptional-contribution, with a launch event for the inception year 2013; the 5-year citizenship qualifying period (t-69da86ba35) is general naturalisation law, kept as a context row without a programme. Box 3 drawdown percentages are illustrative policy parameters, not programme figures.

UK Migration Advisory Committee, 'Tier 1 (Investor) route: investment thresholds and economic benefits' (Feb 2014). UK route statistics, economic estimates, UK and other countries' terms (Tables 4.1-4.3) and other countries' volumes recorded earlier. Now recorded: Prince Edward Island Nominee Program investor stream (para 4.36: opened Jan 2014, 400 places in 2014, C$600,000 net worth, C$150,000 investment) as can-pei-pnp-investor with a launch event; France Table 4.2 row assigned (EUR 10 million and 183 days to fra-exceptional-contribution; 5-year citizenship period kept as a context row).

ledger.contains: GO-FOR-GOLD program update (1 Nov 2025, 12 pp., promoters' material). Recorded earlier: 13 families naturalised in a six-month pilot under s. 27A, pending amendment and regulation, CIO's 21 Oct 2025 confirmation, fee table, due-diligence fees, PR special dependants, gold offset up to 20 kg, target timelines. Now: all its rules, claims and events assigned to sle-go-for-gold; added the 'Launched in January 2025' launch account, the s. 27A Citizenship Act 1973 legal-basis event, the 2% gold discount, the USD 10,000 due-diligence fee for families of 6-10 (p. 4 table), and due diligence taking about two weeks. Not extracted: the due-diligence firm's own track record (2,000+ cases, 15% high-risk rate; not about the programme), the 2028 and 2039 national targets.

Sierra Leone Telegraph (15 Jan 2025, text credited to Imperial-Citizenship): GO-FOR-GOLD fast-track citizenship $140,000 (90 days), heritage route $100,000 (60 days), $10,000 per dependant, ordinary naturalisation 8 years (context row), GFG Club gold bullion discount (2%, up to 20 kg over five years), 66 visa-free destinations, residence rights in 15 ECOWAS countries. Rules and the visa claim now assigned to sle-go-for-gold; added the heritage route's 60 days and the gold discount and 20 kg limit. The 15 ECOWAS countries is a general ECOWAS citizenship benefit, not a programme figure: not extracted.

Two-page press release in the name of the Sierra Leone Immigration Department, 2 Jan 2025 (copy distributed via an industry site; authorised 'SLID / CIO / 23-12-24'): announces arrangements to naturalise high-net-worth foreign investors and people of Sierra Leonean heritage; lists the launch of the GO-FOR-GOLD residency programme in December 2024. No amounts, legal basis or counts. Both events now assigned to sle-go-for-gold; the December 2024 launch sets the programme's launched date.
